title: Scandinavian Style Apartment in Heart of East Nashville
description:
Enjoy a leisurely stroll to several local coffee shop, restaurants, bars, clothing stores and then relax on the sofa in this stylish sanctuary in the heart of hip East Nashville. Cook in the cozy, navy and white kitchen with a farmhouse sink, then dine at the rustic table under the vintage chandelier. It's the perfect hideaway near some East Nashville hot spots. Whether you are a couple looking for a quiet getaway or a solo traveler eager for some adventure, you are sure to love this little corner of Nashville.

Our space features beautiful hardwood floors, farm sink, local art, unique furniture, great natural light, and much more. The space is completely suitable for one person without feeling lonely but can easily hold up to six guests.   

Apartment Features/ Extras:
-Beds (Queen bed, Full pull-out sofa, and queen blow up mattress)
-Pack and Play (upon request)
-Full Kitchen (microwave, coffee pot, dishes, cooking stuff)
-Iron/ Ironing board
-Soap/Shampoo/Conditioner
-Hair dryer
-Filtered water
-Coffee, tea and the fixings
-2 TVs with Cable

During the hours of 10pm-8am we put extra emphasis on quiet hours. 
*We have an additional airbnb listing at this property. If you're traveling with a group, send me a message to book both listings; if not read up on the flow of the property - it's easy, you wont even see each other.

Prior to your check-in it is best to download the AirBnB app, where you will receive all of your check-in information. This is where you will find the code to get into the apartment and everything else you might need to know, even our favorite places to go around the neighborhood. 

Upon arrival, park in the gray gravel spot on the street, walk up the side-walk to the front porch and you are the door on the left (your combination to get in is in the check-in info)

You have access to the front porch, however this area is not part of the rental but rather communal space if you need to rest outside for a short time. Other than that, the space you are renting is the entire upstairs apartment.

We are here to assist you when needed but generally respect your time and space. We do not live on the property, but are frequently around taking care of something. We live exactly 1/2 a mile away and can be at the house ASAP if you need us. Please see the "Other Things to Note" section for other things to note.

This area is local, trendy, and diverse while maintaining southern charm with friendly faces. East Nashville is filled with historic homes on shaded streets mixed with trendy coffee shops and amazing restaurants

We are walking distance to some of Nashville's best local restaurants, bars, and coffee shops.  The 5-Points area is 1.5 miles away with loads of other goodies. Trendy shopping and local/organic grocery stores are also within 2 miles and Nissan Stadium is 3.2 miles away.  The bus stop is within a very short walking distance (but no one uses it so plan to Uber).

You are not the only ones on the property, so be super nice. During the hours of 10pm-8am we put extra emphasis on quiet hours in order to give our guest the restful retreat they are here for.

Here is the layout:

Upstairs - You.

Downstairs - Our long term tenants.

host_details:
Cass and I love our neighborhood. We have lived here for five years and between the local shops, good friends and great community we are finding that it is a wonderful place to raise our two kids. Over the years we have dabbled in different things, but they have all centered around helping others and making spaces look great. We are in the real-estate world; managing properties and bringing new life into old neighborhoods by remodeling houses. We love sharing what we do with others and honestly want you to feel that our home and the spaces that we have created are your home - or at least wish they were your home. We hope that we can be more than just a host for your trip, but that we can be a resource for you. We often have guest moving to Nashville. If you would like to see some homes or get a tour of the neighborhoods just ask ahead of time and we will take care of the rest.
